messages.subject: Sampling weights and WLS estimator
parts:
Hello,

I've recently estimated a structural equation model in lavaan using a weighted least squares estimator, since many of the indicators of the latent variables are categorical. I used the sampling.weights argument to incorporate a base weight to account for survey design before reading that lavaan (and lavaan.survey?) doesn't yet support the use of weights with a WLS estimator. When I ran the model, however, I didn't receive any error messages or indications that something was wrong and my output showed normal, error- and warning- free results. The weight variable is listed in the output, implying that it was used in the analysis without issue.

I understand that I probably shouldn't trust the results of the model since the lavaan manual says weights aren't supported with WLS but given the normal results, I'm not sure exactly why. I assume lavaan isn't properly incorporating the weights but how exactly is it estimating the model parameters when passed this unsupported model and in what ways are these results incorrect?

Thanks for your help
